table.name: PAN_APP_SELECT
table.script:
# 应用选择器：扫描 midletapp 下 *.jar，icon 取 jar 内 png，每页 30 个 # J2meScriptLib 经 XmlExtAssist.addExtScriptLib 注册，脚本直接调用 sub oninit() def("pageSize", 30) def("count", 0) def("page", 0) def("localVer", "") def("remoteVer", "") def("remoteUrl", "") refreshlist() getPolicy() ret
# 先获取 MiniPack 的服务发现策略，再检查当前应用版本 sub getPolicy() if(strlen(getEnv("DISCOVERY_URL")) > 0) checkUpdate() ret eif
policyUrl = getEnv("POLICY_URL") if(strlen(policyUrl) > 0) httpPost(policyUrl, getQueryPara(), "PAN_APP_SELECT.onPolicyRequestBack") eif ret
sub onPolicyRequestBack(url, code, msg) if(code = 0) lines = split(msg, "\n") for(i = 0, i < arrlen(lines), i = i + 1) str = lines[i] eqIdx = indexOf(str, "=") if(eqIdx > 0) key = substr(str, 0, eqIdx) val = substr(str, eqIdx + 1) setEnv(key, val) eif efor checkUpdate() else println("获取更新服务地址失败: " + code + ", " + msg) eif ret
sub getQueryPara() s = "appid=" + getEnv("APPID") + "&appzone=" + getEnv("APPZONE") + "&ver=" + getEnv("SVER") + "&cver=" + getEnv("CVER") + "&from=" + getEnv("FROM") + "&jar=" + getEnv("JAR") + "&lang=" + getEnv("LANG") + "&token=" + getEnv("TOKEN") + "&uuid=" + getEnv("UUID") + "&bundleid=" + getEnv("BUNDLEID") ret s
sub checkUpdate() accBaseUrl = getEnv("ACCOUNT_BASE_URL") if(strlen(accBaseUrl) = 0) println("更新服务地址为空，已跳过版本检查") ret eif
localVer = getJarConfig("version") remoteVer = "" remoteUrl = "" appClass = getJarConfig("app") url = accBaseUrl + "/getpluginversion" post = "app=" + appClass + "&version=" + localVer + "&" + getQueryPara() httpPostAsync(url, post, "PAN_APP_SELECT.onCheckUpdateBack") ret
sub onCheckUpdateBack(url, code, msg) if(code <> 0) println("检查新版本失败: " + code + ", " + msg) ret eif
lines = split(msg, "\n") for(i = 0, i < arrlen(lines), i = i + 1) str = lines[i] eqIdx = indexOf(str, "=") if(eqIdx > 0) key = substr(str, 0, eqIdx) val = substr(str, eqIdx + 1) if(equals(key, "url")) remoteUrl = val eif if(equals(key, "version")) remoteVer = val eif eif efor
if(strlen(remoteUrl) = 0 | strlen(remoteVer) = 0) println("更新服务返回的版本或下载地址为空") ret eif if(compareVersion(localVer, remoteVer) >= 0) ret eif showConfirm("发现新版本 " + remoteVer + "（当前 " + localVer + "），是否下载并安装？", "PAN_APP_SELECT.onUpdateConfirm") ret
sub onUpdateConfirm(code) if(code = 0) ret eif downloadInstall(remoteUrl, "PAN_APP_SELECT.onDownloadInstallBack") ret
sub onDownloadInstallBack(url, code, msg) if(code = 0) showMsg("新版本已安装，请关闭并重新启动应用") else showMsg("下载或安装失败: " + msg) eif ret
sub refreshlist() cnt = scanMidlets() def("count", cnt) def("page", 0) showpage() ret
sub showpage() pages = (count + pageSize - 1) / pageSize if(pages < 1) pages = 1 eif start = page * pageSize end = start + pageSize if(end > count) end = count eif clearList("LIST_APPS") for(i = start, i < end, i = i + 1) nm = getMidletName(i) addListItem("LIST_APPS", i, nm, "onappclick") efor setText("LAB_PAGE", (page + 1) + "/" + pages) if(page > 0) setEnable("BT_PREV", true) else setEnable("BT_PREV", false) eif if(page < pages - 1) setEnable("BT_NEXT", true) else setEnable("BT_NEXT", false) eif ret
sub prevpage() if(page > 0) page = page - 1 showpage() eif ret
sub nextpage() pages = (count + pageSize - 1) / pageSize if(pages < 1) pages = 1 eif if(page < pages - 1) page = page + 1 showpage() eif ret
# 列表项点击：GListItem 单击先 select 再 doAction，getListIdx 取到刚点的项 sub onappclick() idx = getListIdx("LIST_APPS") if(idx >= 0) jp = getMidletJar(idx) runMidlet(jp) eif ret
